claim: Terrain-quality metrics, thresholds, source identities, output custody, ArcGIS deliverables, and decision semantics are fixed before the first real terrain-quality run.

retained_validation_failures.finding: The first continuous north-south plane fixture used reversed global row indices and incorrectly deferred a mathematically discontinuous test seam.
retained_validation_failures.remediation: Corrected only the synthetic fixture coordinates, reran all five tests, and retained the metric implementation and predeclared thresholds unchanged.

limitations: Synthetic arrays prove decision behavior, not real DEM terrain quality or ArcGIS runtime behavior.
The planned review has no independent ground-control or alternate-DEM accuracy comparison.
The pending vertical-datum decision remains a separate required gate even if terrain QA passes.
next_action: Publish the fixed contract and implementation, then run exactly one no-overwrite ArcGIS terrain-quality attempt against the four verified custody files.
